notes_for_editor: Only one source: the tnlandforms.us list. Searches turned up topographic and peak-listing pages for Harrison Ferry Mountain, but no tower history, and no fetchable page could be read. The story is short because the record supports little; the 120-word floor is not met, on purpose. Worth a search of Warren County or Tennessee Division of Forestry records for a build or removal date.
